messages:
harry_docs: quick ask 0 PR changing an SDK snippet (docs/snippets/python_auth.md) to use the new ConnectClient. it's purely doc code but tests fail on the preview because snippet runner uses an older image. can we fast-track this without CODEOWNERS holding it up?

leah_engineer: what's failing in preview exactly? is it lint or the snippet-runner job?

harry_docs: snippet-runner breaks: 
```
ERROR: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'redwood.connect'
```
We didn't change the package name in other examples, just this one. Preview CI passes for lint/build but the snippet test fails because runner image pinned to v1.2.

maria_security: security note: any change that references new SDK surface needs a quick security sign-off? usually not, but we should ensure examples don't leak secrets.

leah_engineer: low risk. suggestion: label as docs/trivial? but GH branch protection requires CODEOWNERS review currently. We could allow the docs team to bypass for certain labels via a bot.

staging-bot: preview build queued for PR #4402. runner-image: pinned v1.2 -> fails.

harry_docs: proposed workflow: if changes are only under docs/snippets/* AND changes are <=3 files AND lines changed < 30 then auto-add label docs/trivial. Then auto-merge allowed once all non-snippet checks pass (lint/build/preview). I can draft the Action.

leah_engineer: +1 but also we need to handle snippet-runner compatibility. maybe the Action should also trigger a snippet-runner rebuild job on the preview infra (update image tag) instead of bypassing snippet tests. skipping snippet tests may hide real regressions.

maria_security: agree with leah. auto-merge should never skip tests that verify code examples run. If the runner is out-of-date, ops should update it.

ci-bot: PR #4402 preview: lint: 705, build: 705, snippet-runner: 74c

harry_docs: okay updated plan:
1) docs-team-owned CODEOWNERS entry for docs/snippets -> @redwood/docs-snippets
2) action auto-label docs/trivial for tiny changes (as described) but only if snippet-runner passes.
3) ops to bump snippet-runner image weekly; I'll open an infra ticket.

leah_engineer: for CODEOWNERS addition, we should keep reviewers as the team not individuals. That lets any team member approve. also propose an "exceptions" checkbox in PR template so authors can explain why it's trivial.

maria_security: I'll sign off on the CODEOWNERS change once you add a short security checklist in the PR template (no secrets, no external keys, minimal deps).

harry_docs: I'll open the docs PRs: one to edit CODEOWNERS, one for the Action, one to update PR template. tagging @leah_engineer for review.

ci-bot: infra ticket #87 opened: bump/snippet-runner-image by @ops.

leah_engineer: small nit: when adding the Action, please ensure it does not auto-label PRs from forks (security risk). only label when author is in org.

harry_docs: good point. will add org-check + add PR template field "trivial-reason".

staging-bot: reminder: avoid merging during release freeze windows (see #releases pinned message).

harry_docs: thanks all. aim to land these changes today so PR #4402 can merge once runner updated.

maria_security: thanks. ping me after templates updated and I'll approve CODEOWNERS change.
